verdict.rationale: Coinbase Payments (CDP) does offer automated behaviors, such as deposit destinations with auto-liquidation, subscriptions and agent wallet skills, so asking whether those automations can be versioned and rolled back is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no versioning, change review or rollback of automation configurations. Approval prompts for agent write actions and spending limits are adjacent controls on individual actions, not versioning of the automations themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
